name: food-website
description: Full-Stack Ghanaian Food Ordering Web App — RAMEDIC Consultancy and Creative Ltd

scripts.build:client: cd client && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:server: cd server && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node seed-ghana-menu.js && node server.js
